name: AM General
old_description: Delivering vehicles is just the beginning of AM General’s commitment to our customer’s needs. Our Aftermarket Fulfillment and Training Center (AFTC) provides the full-range of lifecycle support—from technical manuals and training to maintenance planning, parts, components, kits, and remanufacturing.
about:
AM General is headquartered in South Bend, Indiana. The company does not disclose its founding year or original founders in the provided materials, nor does it specify its ownership structure.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures military and commercial vehicles, including the Humvee family, the Joint Light Tactical Vehicle (JLTV), and the 12‑ton Bastion armored personnel carrier produced in partnership with Arquus. It also developed the Jeep Gladiator XMT concept truck with FCA. AM General operates a 210,000‑square‑foot Aftermarket Fulfillment and Training Center (AFTC) in South Bend that stocks more than 10,000 parts and provides remanufacturing, kitting, and distribution. A 320‑acre off‑road training course, classrooms, hands‑on technical bays, and driving simulators support its training services. Headcount is not disclosed.

Its customer base spans U.S. military vehicle programs, international defense sales in over 70 countries, and commercial automotive sectors. Concrete platforms supported include the Humvee family, medium and heavy tactical trucks, bridging equipment, mine‑detection vehicles, and petroleum and water supply systems. Partnerships with Arquus and FCA illustrate its collaborative approach.

AM General states its mission as "Driven by the Future" and emphasizes full‑lifecycle support — from concept and prototype through production, sustainment, and training — as its distinguishing commitment.
